comment: sptd mode only, temporary until CAS delivers these files. Expects go-args-env-file/manifests/manifest.sptd.template.yaml (plain read-only volumes config-volume and secrets-volume at /etc/sptd-baked/app-config and /etc/sptd-baked/app-secrets, no fieldRef env). Both volumes are baked into the sealed launcher as descriptor files (opened as /proc/self/fd/N) (config-volume first: configs.yaml 100, secrets 101); the program reads /config/configs.yaml and /config/secrets, which the sptd source image (scripts/sptd/images/go-args-env-file) links to those descriptors. The dispatcher checks the links.
